review_notes: Source-first scope: the principal contribution is the valuation-performance ranking of a comprehensive set of value drivers. The authors call alternative multiple-computation approaches related issues; Table 2 Panel A is explicitly their primary results and uses the traditional no-intercept relation with harmonic-mean same-industry comparables. Retain the 17 actual fitted Panel A driver relations only. Table 2 Panels B/C and Table 3 compare other comparator sets or estimation procedures and are secondary to this principal question; later industry/year partitions and ancillary applications are excluded.

FCF and MCF are omitted because the authors say they were dropped from the remainder of the study before the main results owing to negative values and poor performance. P1*, P2*, P3*, ES1, and ES2 are included as value-driver RHS constructions in the retained price/TP fits, not as separate regressions; only the required return-beta fit is a supporting dependency.

All 17 retained baseline sample_size fields are null because 19,879 is the aggregate out-of-sample target/evaluation population, whereas each coefficient fit is target-specific and the exact peer count is not reported. The aggregate remains in sample_description.

The supplied verified reading provides complete P1*, P2*, P3*, ES1, ES2 formulas. P1’s printed terminal term has an unbound s, and P3’s Table 2 and Appendix A horizons conflict; these source issues remain flagged. The beta estimator/equation is also unreported, so no OLS assumption is made.
descriptive_reason: No descriptive statistics for the retained unscaled value-driver variables or the price outcomes are reported. Table 1 is titled “Distribution of Ratio of Value Driver to Price” and reports transformed x/P ratios, not exact/raw/component summaries of the frozen model variables; those ratios are not linked as descriptive rows. The pricing-error distributions in Table 2 are retained as primary model results, not duplicated as descriptive statistics.
results_review_notes: The assigned baseline family is limited to the 17 same-industry harmonic-mean simple-multiple specifications in Table 2 Panel A. Table 2 Panels B/C, intercept-adjusted Table 3, and later additional or robustness analyses are excluded.
